title: Practice 13: The present tense: the Е and И types

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: How much do astronomers make?
exercises.why: **сколько зарабатывают** — сколько with something you can count takes the genitive plural (зарабатывать → зарабатывают).

exercises.prompt: Is this bad for my hair?
exercises.why: **вредить → вредит** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: How are rights and duties correlative?
exercises.why: **соотноситься → соотносятся** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ят belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: I'm taking a week off to do some fishing.
exercises.why: **брать → беру** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.q: Сборщик мусора ___ (приходить) три раза в неделю.
exercises.prompt: The garbage collector comes three times a week.
exercises.why: **приходить → приходит** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.q: Функции в Python ___ (создаваться) с использованием ключевого слова "def".
exercises.prompt: Functions in Python are created using the keyword "def".
exercises.why: **создаваться → создаются** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: I can't with her.
exercises.why: **выдерживать → выдерживаю** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.prompt: This fabric stains easily.
exercises.why: **пачкаться → пачкается** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Tom grinds his teeth in his sleep.
exercises.why: **скрежетать → скрежещет** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: At times the train doesn't arrive on time.
exercises.why: **опаздывать → опаздывает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: I'm preparing the seeds for planting.
exercises.why: **готовить → готовлю** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.q: Я слышу, как ___ (скрипеть) шестерёнки в твоём мозгу.
exercises.prompt: I can hear the sound in your mind.
exercises.why: **скрипеть → скрипят** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ят belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: This vacuum cleaner makes a lot of noise.
exercises.why: **шуметь → шумит** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: I'm keeping an eye on you.
exercises.why: **приглядывать → приглядываю** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.prompt: The action of the story takes place on an island.
exercises.why: **разворачиваться → разворачивается** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: It's getting light. Morning is coming.
exercises.why: **светать → Светает** — present tense,  person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: I often drive over the speed limit.
exercises.why: **превышать → превышаю** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.prompt: Supplies cannot keep up with the demand.
exercises.why: **поспевать → поспевают** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: The president is elected for five year term.
exercises.why: **избираться → избирается** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: В индукционных плитах для непосредственного нагрева кастрюль и сковородок ___ (использоваться) магниты.
exercises.prompt: Induction cookers use magnets to directly heat pots and pans.
exercises.why: **использоваться → используются** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
